description: This file defines the class ADODB2_generic, which extends the ADODB_DataDict class. It provides methods to determine actual data types based on metadata and some database schema modification operations (not supported). It appears to be part of the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer, focusing on generic data dictionary operations.

classes.name: ADODB2_generic
classes.description: Represents a generic data dictionary for database schema operations within the ADOdb library. Includes methods for interpreting metadata types and schema alteration operations.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual database type corresponding to a given metadata type, considering custom types and standard mappings.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Intended to generate SQL statements for altering columns; currently not supported and returns an empty array.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Intended to generate SQL statements for dropping columns; currently not supported and returns an empty array.
